name: 공간 주파수 시간적 분석
algorithm: Spatial Freq Temporal — Frequency Domain Analyzer
mechanism:
This method analyzes the temporal behavior of spatial frequency content across video frames for deepfake detection:

1. **Per-Frame공간적주파수분해**: Each frame is decomposed into spatial frequency bands via 2D FFT or wavelet transform. The energy at each spatial frequency is tracked over time, creating a 3D representation (spatial frequency × orientation × time).

2. **주파수안정성분석**: For static regions, the spatial frequency content should remain stable across frames. The method measures temporal variance at each spatial frequency. Deepfake generation may produce temporally varying frequency content — particularly at high frequencies where generation artifacts fluctuate frame-to-frame.

3. **얼굴-Background주파수일관성**: The temporal behavior of spatial frequencies in face regions vs. background should be similar (same imaging pipeline). The method compares temporal frequency stability between regions. Different temporal stability characteristics indicate different generation/capture sources.

4. **스펙트럼Flicker감지**: The method detects temporal oscillations in specific spatial frequency bands. These "spectral flickers" can arise from: (a) GAN training instabilities producing oscillating artifacts, (b) autoencoder quantization varying between frames, (c) frame-rate conversion creating frequency-domain beating patterns.

5. **NaturalImageStatistics시간적일관성**: Natural images follow the 1/f spatial frequency power spectrum (scale invariance). This relationship should hold consistently across frames. The method tracks the spectral slope over time — systematic temporal variations in the 1/f exponent indicate processing artifacts from AI generation.
parameters:
분석 유형: 주파수
미디어: 비디오
입력: Video frames extracted at key intervals
출력: 신뢰도 점수 (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: 중간~높음 — 70-88% 단독 정확도. Most effective when combined with other 비디오 forensic methods. Performance depends on 비디오 quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detection of deepfake and AI-generated 비디오 through spatial freq temporal analysis. This method examines temporal and spatial features that are difficult for AI systems to perfectly replicate, providing evidence for 비디오 authenticity assessment.
strengths:
• Captures temporal artifacts that single-frame analysis misses
• Works with standard 비디오 formats
• Effective against common deepfake techniques
• Can be combined with other 비디오 forensic methods
• Based on established computer vision research
limitations:
• Performance affected by 비디오 compression and resolution
• Some methods require sufficient frame count for temporal analysis
• Effectiveness varies with deepfake generation technique
• Best used as part of a comprehensive multi-method pipeline
• May produce false positives on heavily edited authentic 비디오
